answer_1.quote: We propose a zero‑shot semantic parser ... without involving NLG tasks such as summarization or translation.

answer_2.quote: We report denotation accuracy on the execution results of predicted programs.

answer_3.quote: We parameterize p(u → u) using generative pre‑trained LMs (BART Large), but we do not use LLMs as judges after generation.

answer_4.quote: Our evaluation relies on automatic denotation accuracy; no human annotators or crowdsourcing were employed.
